description: Reusable map camera moves for MapLibre basemap bakes. Each preset changes the camera relative to its starting state: zoom and bearing deltas follow normalized progress curves ([u, progress] pairs, u in 0..1, interpolated with a monotone cubic), and the pan mode decides how the center moves. Per move, `zoom_to` / `bearing_to` set absolute end values instead of the preset deltas, and `duration_s`, `target`, `path`, `pan_curve`, or `drift_px_per_s` override preset defaults. Expand chained moves into baker keyframes with `vedit camera expand`.

pan_modes.drift: Center drifts at a constant screen velocity (`drift_px_per_s`, x right / y down, measured before bearing rotation).
pan_modes.to_target: Center travels to `target` [lng, lat] along `pan_curve` in Web Mercator space (scale-coupled when zoom changes > 0.25).
pan_modes.fly_to: Center and zoom follow a Van Wijk & Nuij (2003) optimal smooth hyperbolic flight curve to `target` [lng, lat].
pan_modes.path: Center travels along `path` ([[lng, lat], ...], unwrapped longitudes) by cumulative Mercator length along `pan_curve`.

presets.purpose: Hook opener: starts tight on the subject and snaps out to regional context while the map rolls slightly.
Holds a regional frame under narration while a slow push and counter-roll keep the map alive.
Follows a drawn route across continents, accelerating into the long ocean leg while pulling back and swinging the bearing toward the direction of travel.
Pulls from a continental frame to the whole world so the map can fold into a tilted card; pair with an unconstrained renderer transform for zooms below the viewport-fill limit.
Keeps a world card readable under icon or label beats with a barely perceptible westward drift.
Pulls back from a close local frame while a footage iris closes onto the subject marker.
Settles on the origin point with a decelerating pullback and a steady counter-roll while titles land.
Short eased pan that hints at the next destination before the cut.
Silky Van Wijk & Nuij smooth dive from regional/continental context straight onto a focal territory with gentle bearing roll.
High-velocity accelerating plunge into a cross-section or B-roll cut, triggering optical shutter motion blur.
Punch-in landing with damped sinusoidal camera shake on dramatic reveals, hazard slams, or stamp impacts.
Slow living orbital rotation and micro-push during vignette mood-dip question beats.
